title: Wikipedia articles for every concept in the taxonomy
description: English Wikipedia articles that give language-independent background for each concept id in data/concepts.json: the canonical article for the concept first, then closely related articles (named idioms, classic problems, algorithms, theory). Entries are ordered by the taxonomy; the first concept tag of an entry is its primary concept. A few articles are about one language's realisation of a concept (e.g. 'Generics in Java'); those carry a `languages` list. Section anchors were verified against the rendered page. Cross-language comparison tables live in wikipedia-comparisons.json.
